topSlice.title: No client calls /api/apply/confirmation-email after signup after() fix
topSlice.blast: Orphan public POST remains attack surface (rate-limited) and confuses ops about which path sends receipts.
topSlice.evidence: rg '/api/apply/confirmation-email' across *.ts/*.tsx only hits the route itself and lib/rate-limit.ts prefixes — zero importers in app/ or components/. Apply signup now schedules sendApplicationConfirmationEmail via after() in app/api/apply/signup/route.ts:699.

topSlice.title: Missing RESEND_API_KEY soft-fails all branded sends with warn only
topSlice.blast: Every apply/eligibility/employer receipt and admin alert becomes a no-op on a misconfigured deploy; UX copy still promises an automatic email.
topSlice.evidence: lib/email.ts getResend() returns null when process.env.RESEND_API_KEY unset; sendApplicationConfirmationEmail and peers console.warn and return { ok: false } without throwing. docs/EMAIL_SETUP.md documents the key. Confirmation page copy (messages/en.json confirmationHeroBody) promises automatic confirmation email.
